# RDR Technologies

> > RDR Technologies specializes in fire-retardant products, fire suppressants, and specialty chemical coatings for fire safety applications.

RDR Technologies provides commercial fire safety solutions through their online shop, offering a range of fire-retardant treatments, specialty coatings, and fire suppression chemicals. Products are available for purchase with shipping via UPS and FEDEX Ground.

## Key Topics

- fire-retardant products
- fire safety solutions
- specialty chemical coatings
- fire suppressants
- fire-retardant treatments
- protective coatings
- fire protection chemicals
- commercial fire safety
- flame retardant technology
- industrial coatings
